question: Oxides of _______ and ______ dissolve in rain water and form acids which is called as acid rain.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sulphur, nitrogen.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Oxides of sulphur and nitrogen** dissolve in** rainwater and form acids** which is called as acid rain. 
 
• Acid rain is a type of rain that is more acidic than normal due to the **presence of pollutants** in the atmosphere, such as **sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxide,** which react with water to form acids.
 
• Sulphur and nitrogen oxides are mainly produced by human activities such as burning fossil fuels and industrial processes.
 
• Acid rain can have harmful effects on the environment, including damage to forests, lakes, and buildings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Because** phosphorus oxides** dissolve in moisture to form **phosphoric acids, **the smoke from burning phosphorus is **hazardous to the eyes** and **respiratory system.**
 
• The most significant greenhouse gas on Earth is **carbon dioxide**, which both **absorbs and radiates heat.**
 
 
• In contrast to oxygen and nitrogen, greenhouse gases absorb **heat emitted from the Earth's surface **and re-emit it in all directions, including back toward the planet's surface.
 
 
 
• The amount of oxygen breathed from the air can be decreased by **high methane levels.**

• Contact with **calcium oxide** can cause severe **burning and irritation of the skin and eyes.**
 
 
• Calcium oxide can** irritate the lungs**, which can lead to coughing and/or shortness of breath when breathed in. 
 
 
 
• As an antacid, **magnesium oxide **can be used to treat** heartburn and indigestion.**
 
 
• By causing the intestines to release water into the stool, magnesium oxide relieves** constipation and irregular bowel movements.**
